title: alert_delivery_attempts
description: One outbound provider attempt for one alert event channel. Failed attempts may be followed by retries; at most one successful attempt is retained per event and channel.

channel.description: Provider channel used for this attempt, such as telegram or email.

attempted_at.description: Time the provider request was attempted.

status.description: Result returned for this provider attempt.

message.description: Message body submitted to the provider.

provider_message_id.description: Provider-specific successful-message identifier when one is returned.

error_message.description: Concise provider failure detail for a failed attempt.
